description: This is a React-like component written in JavaScript, defining a 'RecipeGrid' UI component using Lightning.js framework. It manages displaying a grid of recipe cards, handling layout, user interaction, and emitting selection events.

methods.name: setItems
methods.description: Sets the list of recipe items to display and resets the selection index.

methods.name: cardX
methods.description: Calculates the x-coordinate for the card at index i.

methods.name: cardY
methods.description: Calculates the y-coordinate for the card at index i.

methods.name: moveSelection
methods.description: Updates the selected index based on navigation input (dx, dy), ensuring it stays within grid bounds.

methods.name: onSelect
methods.description: Emits a 'select' event with the ID of the selected recipe item.
